starters.name: Starters
starters.note: One dependency per capability (web, security, RabbitMQ, observability, app-config, idempotency, persistence), defaults at the lowest priority, every bean backs off.

configuration-metadata.name: Configuration metadata
configuration-metadata.note: Every krizaka.* property completed by the IDE with its description and default; the reference is generated from it.

problem-details.name: Errors as RFC 9457 Problem Details
problem-details.note: Stable codes, requestId, 422 with the field errors, a 500 that never leaks its message.

request-correlation.name: Request correlation
request-correlation.note: X-Request-Id accepted or created, sent back, in the MDC of every log line.

cursor-pagination.name: Cursor pagination
cursor-pagination.note: Opaque cursors, a next page proven without COUNT, size capped.

security-baseline.name: Security baseline and service tokens
security-baseline.note: Stateless chain closed by default, local HS256 verification, SERVICE tokens for /internal/v1.

asymmetric-tokens.name: Asymmetric tokens (JWKS)
asymmetric-tokens.note: Issuer-signed session tokens and per-caller service tokens instead of one shared secret.

outbox.name: Transactional outbox
outbox.note: Events committed with the state, relayed with leasing (no broker I/O inside a transaction), purged.

consumer-retry.name: Consumer retry and dead letters
consumer-retry.note: Quorum queue and DLQ in one line, retry with back-off, then dead-lettered with headers.

message-dedup.name: Idempotent consumption
message-dedup.note: One INSERT claims a message; a failure releases the claim, so nothing is silently dropped.

idempotency-keys.name: HTTP Idempotency-Key
idempotency-keys.note: At most once per key, replay with Idempotent-Replayed, 422 on reuse; PostgreSQL store in the action's transaction. Promoted from Orazaka.

health.name: Actuator health
health.note: outbox (DOWN after repeated failures), dedup (the claims table answers) and appConfig (the store answers, maintenance listed), each with its switch.

observations.name: Micrometer observations and tracing
observations.note: Timers and spans for the outbox relay and publish, the dedup and the idempotency keys; common tags; OpenTelemetry in the starter.

app-version.name: App version compatibility
app-version.note: 426 Upgrade Required below the minimum, N-1 contracts with Deprecation and Sunset, an audited admin API.

test-support.name: Test support
test-support.note: PostgreSQL and RabbitMQ containers, ArchUnit rules, event contract tests; @ServiceConnection and lazy containers are missing.

outbox-store.name: Outbox store, migrations and purges
outbox-store.note: A PostgreSQL outbox that leases rows; Flyway creates the declared stores' tables at startup in their own history; message claims purged on a schedule.

resilience.name: Resilience of the clients
resilience.note: The billing client has tight timeouts; the users client has none yet, and there is no retry or circuit breaker.

rate-limiting.name: Rate limiting
rate-limiting.note: A starter with 429 and Retry-After as Problem Details, promoted from the users service and Orazaka.

webhooks.name: Signed webhooks
webhooks.note: Sign and verify Standard Webhooks, promoted from the notifications service.

openapi.name: OpenAPI
openapi.note: springdoc integration documenting the Problem Details schema; an openapi.json per service contract.

audit.name: Audit trail
audit.note: A reusable audit module, promoted from app-config and the users admin.

i18n.name: Localized errors
i18n.note: Problem Details detail looked up by code in the caller's language.

multi-tenancy.name: Multi-tenancy
multi-tenancy.note: Tenant resolution, in the MDC and in observations.

virtual-threads.name: Virtual threads
virtual-threads.note: The kit's schedulers on virtual threads when the application enables them.

native-image.name: Native image
native-image.note: RuntimeHints for every auto-configuration and an AOT smoke test in CI.
